sources.observation: Four columns frame three tall bronze doors. Above them, the shallow metal roof rises behind paired sculpted lions and a central crest.
The long, two-storey frontage has evenly spaced shuttered windows. Two square columned porches and a lower bowed porch face the grounds.

limitations: Porch depths, individual shutter spacing, roof ridges and the sculpted reliefs are estimated from published exterior views. The model covers the main museum exterior.
